description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

description.zh: 发起删除消息的用户ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
description.en: The ID of the user who deletes the message. The ID must be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits.

description.zh: 发起删除消息的用户扩展信息，长度不超过512字节。
description.en: The additional information about the user who performs the deletion operation. The value can be up to 512 bytes in length.

description.zh: 要删除的消息ID，与发送消息中的MsgTid对应。由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
description.en: The ID of the message that you want to delete. Set this parameter to the value of MsgTid that you specified when you called the SendLiveMessageGroup operation. The ID must be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits.

title.zh: 删除（撤回）某条群组消息

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-message-group-message --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --message-id a74a8fbd3cfe4b2daa8517e4e3000000 --data-center cn-shanghai --deleter-id 1698300000 --deleter-info testname --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveMessageGroupMessage --region cn-hangzhou --DeleterInfo testname --DeleterId 1698300000 --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --GroupId grouptest --MessageId a74a8fbd3cfe4b2daa8517e4e3000000
